capabilities: Open notes in a full-screen zoom viewer
Show kanji readings and meanings on hover
Extract note words containing a kanji
extras: Works fully offline with a bundled KANJIDIC2 dictionary (~3,000 kanji). Pending Obsidian community plugin approval; manual install available. UI in English and Korean; kanji meanings available in English, French, Spanish, or Portuguese, with optional Korean hanja readings.
problem: Small kanji in Japanese study notes are hard to read, and Obsidian has no built-in way to enlarge them or look up readings inline.
summary: Zoom viewer that opens Japanese study notes full-screen at up to 72px, with furigana rendering and offline kanji hover lookups.
